code: (()=>{ const nums=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dmg-num')].map(n=>{const b=n.getBoundingClientRect(); const cs=getComputedStyle(n); return {t:n.textContent,x:+b.x.toFixed(0),y:+b.y.toFixed(0),op:cs.opacity,vis:cs.visibility,tr:cs.transform.slice(0,40)};}).filter(n=>n.vis!=='hidden'); return {scene:__echoes.state().scene, n:nums.length, nums:nums.slice(0,6)}; })()
